description.value:
You have already crossed death once, and you know the way back.

Arayashiki ◆ (free action; frequency once per day; trigger you are reduced to 0 Hit Points or killed)

You keep acting for 1 minute or until the encounter ends. You cannot drop below 1 Hit Point; you are immune to death effects and to the dying, unconscious, and paralyzed conditions; and you ignore the wounded and drained conditions.

When it ends you are dying 3 and your Cloth shatters (one week to repair, or instantly in the hands of a Saint of Aries). If the trigger killed you, you die when the minute ends, beyond the reach of anything short of wish-tier return.

You may end Arayashiki early. If you do, you are merely dying 1 and your Cloth is intact.
